name: Futago to Heaven!
source:
The main character is Minoru from a rich family. His father runs a high school and he belongs to it. He is supposed to have a job as a manager of the dorm for female students after graduation but the manager suddenly quits and he takes over it. "The dorm is full of girls!" Girls come to the manager room night after night to have sex with him and his full of sex life starts...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090403071618/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_48/products_id/1005328]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公塍口稔出身于富裕家庭。他的父亲经营着一所高中，而稔也就读于此。他原定在毕业后担任女生宿舍的管理员，但现任管理员突然辞职，稔只好提前接手这份工作。
“宿舍里全是女孩子！”
女孩们一到夜里便接连来到管理员室，与他发生性关系。稔那“性福”满溢的生活就此开始……
